finding: KSU note 8 cites al-Farra's Ma'ani al-Qur'an with the bare locator (377), while accessible electronic witnesses expose different catalog and pagination schemes. The KSU poem reading هل أنت is not safely assignable to a specific printed edition/page from the currently traceable metadata. IslamWeb displays part 3/page 296 for its electronic text and reads ها أنت; this site locator is not demonstrated to equal printed p.377. A 1955 Cairo catalog record identifies a three-volume Najati/al-Najjar edition, while Quranpedia exposes four PDF attachments under a different, incomplete edition description. These records establish a locator/edition identification gap, not a textual resolution.
